correctness.rationale: For r≥3 shores, any r-clique must pick a vertex from each shore. Deleting E⊆A1xA2 yields CF_r as iterated homotopy pushout of two simplicial cones, naturally Σ^(r-2)Ind(K_{A1,A2} minus E). The neighborhood containment N(u)⊆N(v) gives a free simplicial pivot pairing, deleting v. For a bipartite deleted forest, remove vertices isolated in F and then nontrivial-tree leaves via legal folds until c isolated missing edges remain. Complement independence complex becomes two full shore simplices connected by c parallel edges, giving S0 (c0), point (c1), wedge^(c-1)S1 (c≥2); suspension gives stated integral types. For a nested matching-deletion filtration, c independent bridges attach sequentially; first kills the reduced H0 generator, subsequent bridges create primitive H1 generators, naturally shifted by Mayer-Vietoris to degrees r-2 and r-1. Six-cycle deletion instead yields perfect matching complement and Ind ≃S2, hence CF_r≃S^r; demonstrates essential forest hypothesis. Inspected verify_forest_clique_free.py enumerates all 328 bipartite forests on 3x3 with mod2 homology/fold tests plus higher-partite/cycle tests. Independent small face-Euler check confirms c0,c1,c2,c3 and the six-cycle boundary.

originality.rationale: Ghosh–Selvaraja establishes clique-free complexes and shellability but does not classify all missing bipartite forests or integral persistence. Previous triangle-free joins cover an overlapping suspension special case, and a published two-degree matching-defect formula has different threshold q strictly less than total number of shores, while the present theorem has q=r, arbitrary forest shapes and a c-component classification. The general fold lemma is explicitly prior. Originality is the combined forest-shape invariance and exact persistence, not an uncredited suspension.
residual_risks: Other unpublished special fold proofs may give an equivalent forest-shape formula.
